title: 第891章 血脉蜕变第890章 假戏真做
lines: 第891章谋算（二合一，未完）
看着银月璃这副微微发颤、楚楚可怜的模样，顾云眼底那翻涌的暗潮渐渐平息下来。
他不由失笑一声，轻声道：“行了，做出这种视死如归的模样又是何故？难道我在你心中就这般不近人情？”
少年的声音恢复了一贯的温和，方才那逼人的压迫感如潮水般退去，仿佛从未存在过。
银月璃怔怔地看着他，眼眶里那摇摇欲坠的水光终于没能忍住，顺着眼角无声滑落，洇入鬓发之中。
身为银月狼族的帝女，很多时候她也无法按照自己的内心的想法前进。
“可若是我告诉你，这对你的修为没有影响，甚至有可能，让你的修为大有进境呢？”
“若是如此，你又会做出什么选择？”
正当银月璃打算松口气站起来之时，顾云忽然再度低头，在她的耳畔轻语道。
“你、你这话是什么意思？”
银月璃心头激起千层涟漪，她怔怔地看着眼前这个近在咫尺的少年，声音微微发颤。
“这怎么可能，父亲他明明说过的，银月妖狼一族的元阴关乎血脉根基，若在突破大帝之前失去，便会造成不可挽回的道途损伤。这是族中世代相传的铁律，怎么可能会没有影响？”
“世代相传的铁律？”
顾云轻笑一声，松开环在她腰间的手，从床榻上坐起身来，顺手将她也拉了起来，“那是他不懂万化圣体。”
“相比较血脉之力的提升，破身带来的那点副作用根本就微不足道。”
“你以为，这只是从帝级中期到帝级后期的蜕变，但是实际上……”
“你的未来，根本就无法估量。”
“仙路慢慢，帝级从来就不是终点，远处的风景无穷，你真的想要……止步于此吗？”
银月璃听得愣住了，身为修行之人，有几个人敢说自己不想去看看远处的风景的呢？
“你说的都是真的？”
“自然是真的，我没必要害自己人，当然，前提是你得愿意成为我的自己人。”
“现在，之前询问过你的问题我再问你一次。”
“你愿意……抓住未来吗？”
“我、我愿意！”
银月璃的眼中闪过一抹彻底的坚定，对着少年狠狠地点了下头。
“阿嚏。”
“族长大人，注意保重身体啊。”
“呸！我都已经是大帝八重天的修为，哪里还用得着保重身体！”
看着一旁的狼灭，银月妖帝没好气道：“你这小子，现在就开始编排我了是不是？”
“弟子不敢。”
狼灭低眉顺耳，没有半分趾高气扬的意思，只是唇角微微上扬的那道弧度，怎么看都像是在憋笑。

Chapter 891: Plot (two in one, not finished)
Seeing Yin Yueli's slightly trembling and pitiful appearance, the surging undercurrent in Gu Yun's eyes gradually calmed down.
He couldn't help but laugh and said softly: "Okay, why do you look so resigned to death? Am I so inhumane in your heart?"
The boy's voice returned to its usual gentleness, and the oppressive feeling just now receded like a tide, as if it had never existed.
Yin Yueli stared at him blankly, unable to hold back the shaky water in her eyes, it slipped silently down the corners of her eyes and spread into her hair.
As the emperor's daughter of the Silver Moon Wolf Clan, she often cannot move forward according to her inner thoughts.
"But what if I tell you that this will have no impact on your cultivation, and may even make a great improvement in your cultivation?"
"If so, what choice would you make?"
Just when Yin Yueli was about to breathe a sigh of relief and stand up, Gu Yun suddenly lowered his head again and whispered in her ear.
"W-what do you mean?"
Thousands of ripples arose in Yin Yueli's heart. She stared blankly at the young man so close to her, her voice trembling slightly.
"How is this possible? Father has clearly said that the Yuan Yin of the Silver Moon Demon Wolf clan is related to the bloodline foundation. If it is lost before breaking through to the Great Emperor, it will cause irreparable damage to the road. This is an iron law passed down from generation to generation in the clan. How could it not have any impact?"
"An iron law passed down from generation to generation?"
Gu Yun chuckled, loosened his hand around her waist, sat up from the bed, and pulled her up, "That's because he doesn't understand the Holy Body of All Transformations."
"Compared to the increase in bloodline power, the side effects caused by body destruction are simply insignificant."
"You think this is just a transformation from the middle to the late emperor level, but in fact..."
"Your future is simply immeasurable."
"The road to immortality is slow. The emperor level is never the end. The scenery in the distance is endless. Do you really want to... stop here?"
Yin Yueli was stunned when she heard this. As a cultivator, how many people dare to say that they don't want to see the scenery in the distance?
"Is everything you said true?"
"Of course it's true. I don't need to harm my own people. Of course, the premise is that you must be willing to be one of my own people."
"Now, I'll ask you again the question I asked you before."
"Are you willing to... seize the future?"
"I-I do!"
A flash of complete determination flashed in Yin Yueli's eyes, and she nodded sternly at the young man.
…
"A sneeze."
"Master Patriarch, please take care of yourself."
"Bah! I'm already at the eighth level of the Great Emperor, so there's no need to take care of myself!"
Looking at Lang Mie on the side, Silver Moon Demon Emperor said angrily: "You kid, are you going to start arranging me now?"
"Disciples don't dare."
Lang Mie lowered his eyebrows, not showing any hint of arrogance, but the slight upward curve of the corners of his lips looked like he was suppressing a smile.
